create_fallback_request: create a FallbackCreateRequest to configure model fallbacks with priority-ordered model list
validate_fallback_models: validate fallback_models list contains at least one model with no duplicates
summarize_routing_strategies: summarize all available routing strategies from ROUTING_STRATEGY_DESCRIPTIONS dictionary
list_router_settings_fields: list all configurable router settings fields from ROUTER_SETTINGS_FIELDS array
build_router_settings_field: build a RouterSettingsField describing a single router configuration parameter
